candidates.violated_requirement: Incorrect Gray-to-binary conversion of the MSB, causing wrong binary values and subsequent incorrect Gray code output. The mutation will cause the counter to produce incorrect Gray codes starting from the first increment.
candidates.spec_basis: The spec requires correct Gray-to-binary conversion where each binary bit should be derived from the corresponding Gray code bit and higher bits.

candidates.violated_requirement: Binary increment by 2 instead of 1, causing the Gray code sequence to skip values and produce incorrect outputs every other cycle.
candidates.spec_basis: The spec requires incrementing the binary value by exactly 1 to generate the next Gray code in sequence.

candidates.violated_requirement: Incorrect binary-to-Gray conversion by shifting right by 2 bits instead of 1, producing wrong Gray code outputs that don't follow the single-bit change property.
candidates.spec_basis: The spec requires converting binary to Gray code by XORing the binary value with itself shifted right by 1 bit.

candidates.violated_requirement: Incorrect final Gray code output by adding 1 to the converted value, breaking the single-bit change property and producing wrong sequence values.
candidates.spec_basis: The spec requires outputting the exact Gray code value obtained from the binary-to-Gray conversion without modification.
